source.name: Ministry of Sport – 'Puma enters long-term partnership with New Zealand Football'
source.quote: Puma will take charge of designing and producing both home and away kits, along with training wear, for all 10 of New Zealand's national football teams.
source.note: Kit maker, not a shirt-sponsor placement; listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. 2026 shirts verified sponsor-free against Puma launch photos (front, back, sleeves) and the 26 June 2026 World Cup match v Belgium.

summary: Nothing on the shirt but the fern: the All Whites' 2026 home kit carries no commercial sponsors, only the New Zealand Football crest and kit-maker Puma's logo.
